paper.abstract_en: Topological Holography (TH) is a framework of representing $(d-1)$-dimensional quantum systems with a $d$-dimensional sandwich, consisting of a topological order bulk, a gapped top boundary and a dynamical bottom boundary. Dualities and non-invertible symmetries are represented by the change of top boundary in the TH framework. Existing studies have focused on sandwiches with liquid topological bulk, in this paper we examine some fracton bulks, where we call the framework Fracton Topological Holography (FTH). In particular, the X-cube FTH induces the transverse field plaquette Ising model (TFPIM) version Kramers--Wannier duality, the duality between TFPIM and the two-dimensional $90^\circ$ quantum compass model, and the self-duality of quantum compass model. Haah's code FTH induces a duality of transverse-field generalized Ising models (TFGIMs). The two examples illustrate at least a part of type-I fracton (X-cube) and a part of type-II fracton (Haah's code) models can be used to construct FTH sandwiches. Moreover, we construct an explicit Sequential Quantum Circuit (SQC) switching the top boundary of X-cube sandwich, realizing the TFPIM version KW duality.
